source.title: Irish News, 4 November 1946, p. 5 ("Rural Council election results")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: New members from the Derry Journal (18 October 1946, p. 7).

note: Triennial election of Magherafelt rural district (26 divisions), Co. Londonderry polls postponed to 31 October 1946. Twenty-eight nominations were received on 17 October for twenty-six seats: Bellaghy and Magherafelt were contested and the other twenty-four divisions had one candidate each, declared elected without a poll (Returning Officer's notice, Mid-Ulster Mail, 26 October 1946, p. 6). The earlier record's seven new members carried a 'U.' label the paper did not print and two names misread from the OCR (Moore for Noone, Victor for George Victor Holmes); replaced from the notice (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Speers was the outgoing member. Poll 92 per cent; 3 spoiled votes.
